subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept openai/codex-action 1.11 for workflows that execute with an OpenAI API key after reviewing the upstream source and release delta from 1.8?
rationale: The PR changes a third-party executable action at a credential boundary; a source-level contract review and the acceptable trust posture require maintainer intent.

options.title: Audit then accept the revision
options.body: Review the pinned upstream action source and release delta for credential handling and runner behavior, then merge if the established trust boundary remains intact.

options.title: Hold the Codex action at 1.8
options.body: Accept the other action updates separately or in a revised dependency PR while retaining the currently reviewed Codex-action pin.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Close or supersede this grouped bump if maintaining a combined action-upgrade cadence is not worth the credential-bound review cost.

recommendation.title: Audit then accept the revision
recommendation.body: Review the pinned upstream action source and release delta for credential handling and runner behavior, then merge if the established trust boundary remains intact.
